reason: The case checks compile-time XML iteration and type incompatibilities using supported XML templates, XML subtype iteration, anonymous callbacks, xml:forEach, xml:iterator and ordinary iterator next method calls. test_design_notes: Contains only @error expectations; no @args, @panic or @output behavior to assess.

Several @error markers occur on foreach loops over corresponding singleton XML subtypes; these expectations merit review because XML subtype iteration is explicitly supported. This is an expectation issue, not evidence of an unsupported feature.
The wildcard-only destructuring-assignment restriction does not apply to the list binding pattern in foreach.
